items: LAGOS STATE (PSI 9.6): Governor Sanwo-Olu Advocates Global Renewable Energy Financing for Lagos at COP31 Summit
EBONYI STATE (PSI 9.5): Governor Nwifuru Reconstructs 295-Hectare L-PRES Centre to Create 2,000 Jobs in Izhiangbo
PLATEAU STATE (PSI 9.4): Governor Mutfwang Imposes Curfew in 3 LGAs and Disburses ₦1.5bn Humanitarian Aid to Displaced Families
FCT ABUJA (PSI 9.3): Minister Wike Inspects Infrastructure Corridors, Sets Jan 2027 Completion Deadline, Defends Coalition
CROSS RIVER STATE (PSI 9.2): RMAFC Reopens Oil Well Verification Probe as Cross River Distributes Improved Cowpea Seeds
NIGER STATE (PSI 9.1): Governor Bago Receives Federal Lawmakers and Stakeholders Over Deceased Miners, Warns Lawbreakers
KADUNA STATE (PSI 9.0): Governor Uba Sani Commissions Basic Education Interventions and Distributes Quality Assurance Vehicles
ONDO STATE (PSI 8.9): Ondo State Kickstarts 4-Week Intensive Solar Panel Installation Training for Youths
BENUE STATE (PSI 8.8): Governor Alia Receives Assets Inquiry Report and Suspends Muslim Pilgrims Board Leadership
AKWA IBOM STATE (PSI 8.7): Governor Umo Eno Commissions 14.8km Internal Roads Project in Awa, Onna LGA
ABIA STATE (PSI 8.6): Catholic Bishop Praises Gov. Otti's Integrity; Governor Pledges Priests' Retirement Home and Airport Progress
EDO STATE (PSI 8.5): Edo Government and Partners Launch Free Cataract Surgeries for Over 200 Residents in Benin City
GOMBE STATE (PSI 8.4): Governor Inuwa Yahaya Approves Strategic Reshuffling and Posting of 35 Permanent Secretaries
ENUGU STATE (PSI 8.3): Governor Mbah and SEDC Prepare to Flag Off Pilot Regional Agro-Development Program in Nomeh
ZAMFARA STATE (PSI 8.2): Zamfara Government and IOM Inspect Construction of GBV Survivors' Safe Space Centre in Gusau
KEBBI STATE (PSI 8.1): Governor Nasir Idris Condemns Attack on Lafagu Village Head and Orders Security Reinforcement

LAGOS (PSI 9.6): Advocated for African renewable financing at the Global Renewables Summit, confirming 15 approved clean power distribution projects across Lagos while demanding equitable global risk capital.

EBONYI (PSI 9.5): Inspected ongoing construction of the 295-acreage L-PRES Livestock Project in Izhiangbo, where 27 administrative and academic building contracts have been awarded to generate 2,000 workforce jobs.

PLATEAU (PSI 9.4): Declared an immediate 6:00 PM – 6:00 AM curfew in Barkin Ladi, Bokkos, and Mangu LGAs, while disbursing ₦1.5 billion in combined humanitarian aid (₦1bn from First Lady Sen. Oluremi Tinubu's RHI and ₦500m state funds) to 1,571 displaced households.

FCT ABUJA (PSI 9.3): Inspected major road corridors including ISEX, Southern Parkway, and Nile University Road, confirming a strict January 2027 completion deadline while defending his cross-party 'Rainbow Coalition' on national television.

CROSS RIVER (PSI 9.2): RMAFC reconstituted an inter-agency committee to re-verify 245 disputed oil wells drilled since 2017 to test Cross River's 13% derivation claims, while the Agriculture Ministry began statewide SAMPEA 20-T cowpea seed distribution.

NIGER (PSI 9.1): Received condolence visits from federal lawmakers led by Rep. Betara, Sen. Sani Bello, and Permanent Secretaries over 37 deceased artisanal miners, warning that criminals hijacking protests will face full prosecution.

KADUNA (PSI 9.0): Commissioned renovated basic education facilities at LEA Sultan Bello Primary School, Kaduna, and distributed operational motorcycles to Quality Assurance Officers across all 23 LGAs.
ONDO (PSI 8.9): BATVE, in partnership with FMLE and GIZ, launched a 4-week intensive Solar Panel Installation Training in Akure for selected youths across all 18 LGAs to promote energy self-reliance.

BENUE (PSI 8.8): Received the three-volume Judicial Commission Report on Government Assets (2024-2026) to prepare a White Paper, while approving the 3-month suspension of the Muslim Pilgrims Board leadership over petition allegations.

AKWA IBOM (PSI 8.7): Commissioned 14.8km of internal roads and a 1.9km spur with drains in Awa, Onna LGA, honoring predecessor Mr. Udom Emmanuel while reviewing 26 ongoing infrastructure projects in the council.

ABIA (PSI 8.6): Bishop Augustine Echema praised Gov. Alex Otti's integrity during his 40th priestly anniversary in Aba; Gov. Otti announced a privately funded retirement home for priests and reported significant runway progress at Abia Airport Nsulu.
EDO (PSI 8.5): Edo Ministry of Health and African Cataract Eye Foundation commenced free cataract eye surgeries for over 200 beneficiaries in Benin City to restore vision and economic independence.
GOMBE (PSI 8.4): Approved the strategic posting and reshuffling of 35 Permanent Secretaries across state ministries and agencies, setting a strict handover completion deadline of September 25, 2026.
ENUGU (PSI 8.3): Finalized arrangements with the South East Development Commission (SEDC) to flag off a pilot regional agro-development program at Nomeh Unataeze in Nkanu East LGA.
ZAMFARA (PSI 8.2): Inspected ongoing construction of the IOM-supported Safe Space Centre in Gusau, designed to provide psychosocial care and rehabilitation for survivors of gender-based violence.

KEBBI (PSI 8.1): Condemned the killing of Lafagu Village Head Alhaji Saidu Mujeli in Bagudo LGA, assuring Kaoje communities of intensified security operations to enable safe return for displaced residents.
